name: Whirlwind of Strikes (Combat)
body:
When you find an opening in an opponent’s defenses you don’t let up.

Prerequisite(s): Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +6, sneak attack +2d6.

Benefit: When you take a full attack action and deal damage to an opponent with two or more different weapons you may immediately make an additional attack at your highest base attack bonus.

For the purposes of this attack treat your opponent as though they were being flanked by you. This feat can trigger once per round per opponent. For example, if you are capable of making four attacks in a full attack and you split those attacks between two opponents, if you hit each opponent with two different weapons, you make an immediate attack against each opponent separately.
